title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Building-Failure Uplift on Late Claim Payments
content:
These questions are answered from the building-failure rule for approvals paid late under the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan.

**What does the building-failure uplift add?**
Interest of the outstanding approved amount multiplied by the uplift and by the payment's late days, divided by 365.

**What are its values?**
The building-failure uplift is 0.03 a year when the claim carries a facility work-order reference and its peril is sudden water damage or roof collapse, 0.01 when it carries a work-order reference with any other peril, and nothing otherwise.

| Facility work-order reference on the claim | Peril on the claim | Uplift (a year) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| present | sudden water damage or roof collapse | 0.03 |
| present | any other peril | 0.01 |
| absent | any | nothing |

**Where is the work-order reference?**
On the claim as filed: the facility work-order number logged by facility staff for a building or climate-control failure behind the loss.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** An outstanding amount of 730.00, a roof collapse with a work-order reference, and 50 late days: 730.00 multiplied by 0.03 and by 50, divided by 365, is 3.00.
